title: Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking
sub: Words for analysing, reasoning, deciding and debugging.

cards.def:
To examine very carefully
हिंदी: बारीकी से जाँचना
examples: The auditors scrutinised every transaction.
The bank scrutinised my documents before approving the loan.
Scrutinise the contract before you sign it.
Every expense claim is scrutinised by the finance team.

cards.def:
To analyse something piece by piece
हिंदी: टुकड़ों में बाँटकर विश्लेषण करना
examples: The team dissected the incident minute by minute.
The cricket experts dissected every ball of the final over.
In the review, we dissected why the campaign failed.
Students dissected the poem line by line.

cards.def:
To break down a complex idea into its parts
हिंदी: जटिल विचार को घटकों में तोड़ना
examples: Let's deconstruct the requirement into testable pieces.
The teacher deconstructed the essay to show its structure.
Let's deconstruct the customer journey step by step.
He deconstructed the popular myth with simple facts.

cards.def:
To combine different ideas into a coherent whole
हिंदी: विभिन्न विचारों को जोड़कर एक रूप देना
examples: She synthesised feedback from five teams into one proposal.
The report synthesises data from twenty customer interviews.
A good manager synthesises different opinions into one plan.
Can you synthesise these notes into a one-page summary?

cards.def:
To estimate beyond known data based on trends
हिंदी: ज्ञात डेटा से आगे का अनुमान लगाना
examples: We extrapolated next year's storage from current growth.
If sales keep growing like this, we can extrapolate a record year.
Don't extrapolate too much from one week of data.
We extrapolated the cost for all offices from one branch.

cards.def:
To conclude from evidence and reasoning
हिंदी: प्रमाण से निष्कर्ष निकालना
examples: We can infer from the logs that the retry never ran.
From her smile, I inferred that the interview went well.
What can we infer from the drop in website visits?
Readers can infer the ending from the clues.

cards.def:
To reach a conclusion by logical reasoning
हिंदी: तर्क से निष्कर्ष निकालना
examples: He deduced the cause from the sequence of errors.
From the wet umbrella, she deduced it was raining outside.
We deduced that the email was fake from the wrong spelling.
The detective deduced who the thief was.

cards.def:
To arrive at a judgement after consideration
हिंदी: निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना
examples: We concluded that the cache was not the culprit.
The doctor concluded that it was only a mild allergy.
After the survey, we concluded that customers want lower prices.
Don't conclude anything until all the data is in.

cards.def:
To suppose without firm evidence
हिंदी: बिना ठोस प्रमाण अनुमान लगाना
examples: I surmise the vendor changed their format overnight.
From his tired face, I surmised he hadn't slept well.
We can only surmise why the client cancelled.
She surmised that the meeting was cancelled when nobody came.

cards.def:
To form a theory without firm evidence
हिंदी: अटकल लगाना
examples: It's pointless to speculate before we see the logs.
The media speculated about the actor's next film.
Don't speculate about the layoffs; wait for the official update.
Experts speculate that prices will rise next year.

cards.def:
To show a mutual relationship between things
हिंदी: आपसी संबंध दिखाना
examples: Errors correlate strongly with the nightly batch.
Higher income often correlates with better health.
Do sales correlate with the ad campaign dates?
Sleep quality correlates with how productive I feel.

cards.def:
The relationship of cause and effect
हिंदी: कारण-परिणाम संबंध
examples: We need evidence of causation, not just correlation.
Ice cream sales and drowning both rise in summer, but that isn't causation.
The study could not prove causation.
Be careful about claiming causation from a simple chart.

cards.def:
Relating to cause and effect
हिंदी: कारणात्मक
examples: There's no causal link between the two incidents.
Scientists found a causal link between smoking and cancer.
Is there a causal relationship between training and sales?
We need a causal explanation, not just a guess.

cards.def:
One of several things that led to a result
हिंदी: योगदान देने वाला कारक
examples: Time pressure was a contributing factor to the error.
Heavy rain was a contributing factor in the accident.
Poor sleep was a contributing factor to my bad exam result.
Unclear requirements were a contributing factor to the delay.

cards.def:
Fundamental but not immediately obvious
हिंदी: अंतर्निहित
examples: The underlying problem is a lack of ownership.
Stress was the underlying cause of his headaches.
We fixed the symptoms, but the underlying issue remains.
There's an underlying tension between the two departments.

cards.def:
To show or appear clearly
हिंदी: प्रकट होना
examples: The bug manifests only under heavy load.
Stress can manifest as back pain or poor sleep.
Her talent for music manifested at a young age.
The problem manifested itself as slow page loads.

cards.def:
To make a problem worse
हिंदी: समस्या को और बिगाड़ना
examples: Retrying aggressively exacerbated the overload.
Shouting will only exacerbate the argument.
The heavy rain exacerbated the traffic jam.
Skipping meals can exacerbate acidity.

cards.def:
To make a problem worse by adding to it
हिंदी: समस्या को और जटिल बनाना
examples: Late approvals compounded the delay.
Missing the train compounded my bad morning.
Lying about the error only compounded the problem.
High interest rates compounded the company's debt problems.

cards.def:
To make a problem less severe
हिंदी: समस्या की गंभीरता कम करना
examples: Caching alleviated the pressure on the database.
The medicine alleviated her pain quickly.
Hiring two more people will alleviate the workload.
A clear plan can alleviate anxiety before exams.

cards.def:
To find a solution to a problem
हिंदी: समाधान ढूँढना
examples: We resolved the issue by upgrading the driver.
The two friends resolved their argument over coffee.
Customer support resolved my billing problem in a day.
Let's resolve this before the weekend.

cards.def:
To put something right
हिंदी: ठीक करना
examples: Please rectify the error in the report.
The shop rectified the billing mistake and refunded me.
We rectified the error before the client noticed.
The company promised to rectify the faulty products.

cards.def:
To deal with a problem
हिंदी: समस्या से निपटना
examples: We must address the root cause, not just the symptom.
The minister promised to address the water shortage.
Address the client's concerns before discussing price.
We'll address your question at the end of the session.

cards.def:
To confront and deal with a difficult problem
हिंदी: कठिन समस्या से जूझना
examples: The team tackled the backlog one category at a time.
The city is trying to tackle air pollution.
Tackle the hardest task first when your energy is high.
She tackled the difficult conversation with honesty.

cards.def:
To find a way around an obstacle
हिंदी: बाधा से बचकर निकलना
examples: They circumvented the limit by batching requests.
Some companies circumvent tax rules with clever accounting.
They circumvented the traffic by taking a smaller road.
Never circumvent security checks, even in a hurry.

cards.def:
To go around something instead of through it
हिंदी: किसी को छोड़कर आगे बढ़ना
examples: Don't bypass the approval process for convenience.
The new flyover lets us bypass the city centre.
Hackers tried to bypass the login page.
He bypassed his manager and went straight to the director.

cards.def:
An alternative approach that avoids a problem
हिंदी: अस्थायी विकल्प
examples: A workaround solution kept the service running.
Until the printer is fixed, emailing the PDF is our workaround solution.
The workaround solution is slow, but it works.
Document the workaround solution so support can use it.

cards.def:
A temporary remedy that doesn't solve the real problem
हिंदी: कामचलाऊ उपाय
examples: Restarting the service is a band-aid solution.
Giving a discount is a band-aid solution for a poor product.
Overtime is a band-aid solution to understaffing.
We need a real fix, not another band-aid solution.

cards.def:
A simple solution that seems to solve a complex problem
हिंदी: हर समस्या का जादुई हल
examples: There's no silver bullet for data quality.
There's no silver bullet for losing weight; you need diet and exercise.
Don't expect the new tool to be a silver bullet.
Many people think AI is a silver bullet for every problem.

cards.def:
A fix designed to last
हिंदी: दीर्घकालिक समाधान
examples: We need a long-term solution for vendor delays.
Building a metro is a long-term solution to traffic.
Hiring more staff is the long-term solution, not overtime.
Let's find a long-term solution instead of fixing it every week.

cards.def:
To repeat a process to improve results
हिंदी: बार-बार सुधार करना
examples: Let's iterate on the design based on feedback.
We iterate on the menu every month based on customer feedback.
Ship a simple version first, then iterate.
The design team iterated through five versions of the logo.

cards.def:
Happening in small, gradual steps
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़ने वाला
examples: An incremental rollout reduces risk.
Incremental savings each month add up over the years.
We made incremental improvements to the app every week.
Small, incremental changes are easier to test.

cards.def:
To propose an explanation to be tested
हिंदी: परिकल्पना बनाना
examples: We hypothesised that the delay came from the network.
The scientist hypothesised that the plant needed more light.
We hypothesise that users leave because the form is too long.
Hypothesise first, then collect data to check.

cards.def:
To check whether an idea is correct
हिंदी: सिद्धांत की जाँच करना
examples: Let's test the theory with a smaller dataset.
I think the noise comes from the fan; let's test the theory.
We tested the theory by changing one setting at a time.
Before spending money, test the theory with a small pilot.

cards.def:
To eliminate a possibility
हिंदी: संभावना को ख़ारिज करना
examples: We ruled out hardware as the cause.
The doctor ran tests to rule out infection.
We can't rule out a delay due to the strike.
She ruled out moving abroad for now.

cards.def:
To reduce possibilities to find the answer
हिंदी: कारणों को सीमित करना
examples: Narrow it down by disabling features one by one.
There are many flats available, so let's narrow it down by budget.
The mechanic narrowed it down to the battery or the starter.
Can you narrow it down to your top three choices?

cards.def:
A factor kept constant in an experiment
हिंदी: नियंत्रित चर
examples: Keep data volume as a control variable in the test.
In the experiment, temperature was the control variable.
Keep the price as a control variable while testing the ad.
Without a control variable, the results are hard to trust.

cards.def:
The number of observations in a study
हिंदी: नमूने का आकार
examples: The sample size is too small to draw conclusions.
Ten customers is too small a sample size for a survey.
With a larger sample size, the results became clearer.
Always mention the sample size in your report.

cards.def:
A data point far from the others
हिंदी: सामान्य से बहुत अलग मान
examples: One outlier skewed the average latency.
One very rich family is an outlier in this neighbourhood.
Remove the outlier before calculating the average.
His score was an outlier; everyone else scored much lower.

cards.def:
To distort a result in a particular direction
हिंदी: परिणाम को एक ओर झुका देना
examples: A few huge files skew the processing time.
A few extreme answers can skew the survey results.
Holiday sales skew the December numbers.
Don't let personal feelings skew your judgement.

cards.def:
Unlikely to have occurred by chance
हिंदी: सांख्यिकीय रूप से महत्वपूर्ण
examples: The improvement is statistically significant.
The difference between the two groups was not statistically significant.
We need more users for a statistically significant result.
The study found a statistically significant drop in infections.

cards.def:
The possible range of difference in a measurement
हिंदी: त्रुटि की संभावित सीमा
examples: The margin of error is about three percent.
The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus two percent.
With such a small margin of error, the results are reliable.
Leave some margin of error in your budget.

cards.def:
A range likely to contain the true value
हिंदी: विश्वास अंतराल
examples: The confidence interval is narrow, so we trust the estimate.
The report gives a 95 percent confidence interval for the average.
A wide confidence interval means we're less sure of the number.
Add the confidence interval to the chart so readers see the range.

cards.def:
The middle value in a sorted data set
हिंदी: माध्यिका
examples: The median latency is better than the average suggests.
The median salary is a better guide than the average.
The median house price in the city rose by eight percent.
Sort the numbers first to find the median.

cards.def:
A value below which a given percentage of data falls
हिंदी: प्रतिशतक
examples: The ninety-ninth percentile latency matters most to customers.
My son's height is in the 80th percentile for his age.
Look at the 95th percentile, not just the average.
She scored in the top percentile in the entrance exam.

cards.def:
How values are spread across a data set
हिंदी: वितरण
examples: File sizes follow a skewed distribution.
The distribution of income in the country is very uneven.
Let's plot the distribution of customer ages.
Most of the distribution is under five minutes.

cards.def:
Predictable patterns that repeat at certain times
हिंदी: मौसमी पैटर्न
examples: Month-end seasonality drives our peak load.
Ice cream sales show strong seasonality.
Our travel business has clear seasonality around Diwali.
Remove seasonality before comparing months.

cards.def:
A repeated or regular form
हिंदी: पैटर्न
examples: We noticed a pattern of failures every Monday.
I see a pattern: he's always late on Mondays.
Look for patterns in customer complaints.
The data shows a clear pattern of higher sales on weekends.

cards.def:
An irregular rise and fall
हिंदी: उतार-चढ़ाव
examples: Fluctuations in volume make capacity planning hard.
Fluctuations in the rupee affect our import costs.
Small fluctuations in weight are normal.
We saw some fluctuation in traffic during the holidays.

cards.def:
A period where progress levels off
हिंदी: स्थिरता का दौर
examples: Performance gains reached a plateau after the third change.
My weight loss hit a plateau after two months.
Sales reached a plateau after the first year.
Learning often has a plateau before the next big jump.

cards.def:
To fall sharply and suddenly
हिंदी: तेज़ी से गिरना
examples: Throughput plummeted after the change.
Temperatures plummeted overnight in Delhi.
The company's shares plummeted after the bad results.
Sales plummeted when the competitor cut prices.

cards.def:
To rise rapidly to a high level
हिंदी: तेज़ी से ऊपर चढ़ना
examples: Cloud costs soared during the migration.
House prices soared in the city last year.
Her confidence soared after the successful presentation.
Onion prices soared after the heavy rains.

cards.def:
To rise and fall irregularly
हिंदी: ऊपर-नीचे होते रहना
examples: Response times fluctuate throughout the day.
Vegetable prices fluctuate with the seasons.
His mood fluctuates a lot during exams.
Our website traffic fluctuates between weekdays and weekends.

cards.def:
To become steady and unchanging
हिंदी: स्थिर होना
examples: Error rates stabilised after the patch.
The patient's condition stabilised after the treatment.
Prices should stabilise after the festival season.
Once the team stabilises, we can take on new projects.

cards.def:
To come together towards a common point
हिंदी: एक बिंदु पर मिलना
examples: Estimates from both teams converged on four weeks.
Different opinions slowly converged into one plan.
Two highways converge near the airport.
Our goals converged once we understood each other's needs.

cards.def:
To move apart or differ
हिंदी: अलग दिशा में जाना
examples: The two environments have started to diverge.
Our opinions diverge on the best way to save money.
The road diverges into two paths after the bridge.
The design and the final product diverged a lot.

cards.def:
To depart from the expected path
हिंदी: सामान्य से हटना
examples: Results deviate from the model in extreme conditions.
Don't deviate from the recipe the first time you cook it.
The flight deviated from its route because of the storm.
If you deviate from the plan, let the team know.

cards.def:
Examination of differences between expected and actual figures
हिंदी: अंतर का विश्लेषण
examples: Discrepancy analysis found a missing currency conversion.
A discrepancy analysis of the stock showed items missing from the warehouse.
Finance runs a discrepancy analysis at the end of every quarter.
The discrepancy analysis explained why the budget and actual costs differed.

cards.def:
A method of identifying the fundamental reason for a problem
हिंदी: मूल कारण विश्लेषण
examples: Root cause analysis pointed to an unchecked assumption.
Do a root cause analysis before you promise it won't happen again.
The root cause analysis showed that training was the real gap.
Every major incident needs a written root cause analysis.

cards.def:
A technique of repeatedly asking why to find the root cause
हिंदी: पाँच बार क्यों पूछने की विधि
examples: The five whys revealed a missing alert.
Using the five whys, we found the real reason for late deliveries.
The five whys is simple, but it works for many problems.
Don't stop at the first answer; try the five whys.

cards.def:
A visual tool mapping possible causes of a problem
हिंदी: कारणों का रेखाचित्र
examples: We used a fishbone diagram to list possible causes.
The quality team drew a fishbone diagram on the whiteboard.
A fishbone diagram groups causes into people, process and tools.
Our fishbone diagram showed that most causes were in the process.

cards.def:
A table scoring options against criteria
हिंदी: निर्णय तालिका
examples: We scored vendors using a decision matrix.
I used a decision matrix to choose between three job offers.
The decision matrix made the final choice less emotional.
Share the decision matrix so everyone sees how we decided.

cards.def:
Standards on which a judgement is based
हिंदी: मानदंड
examples: The selection criteria include cost and reliability.
What criteria do you use to choose a school for your child?
The candidate met all the criteria for the role.
Agree on the criteria before you compare the options.

cards.def:
The importance assigned to a factor
हिंदी: महत्व का भार
examples: We gave resilience a higher weighting than cost.
In the exam, the project carries a weighting of forty percent.
Give more weighting to customer feedback than to internal opinions.
The weighting of each factor changed the final ranking.

cards.def:
A structured method for ranking work
हिंदी: प्राथमिकता तय करने का ढाँचा
examples: We use a simple prioritisation framework of impact and effort.
Our prioritisation framework ranks requests by customer value.
A prioritisation framework stops the loudest person from winning.
Explain the prioritisation framework to stakeholders upfront.

cards.def:
A comparison of benefit against work needed
हिंदी: प्रभाव बनाम प्रयास
examples: Plot tasks by impact and effort to pick quick wins.
Compare impact and effort before you start any new task.
Low impact and high effort tasks should usually wait.
We sorted the ideas into a grid of impact and effort.

cards.def:
A small action producing a noticeable result
हिंदी: कम प्रयास में स्पष्ट लाभ
examples: Better alert names were a quick win.
Changing the button colour was a quick win for sign-ups.
Start with a quick win to build the team's confidence.
Cleaning up old files was a quick win for disk space.

cards.def:
Easy tasks that bring immediate benefit
हिंदी: आसानी से मिलने वाला लाभ
examples: Let's pick the low-hanging fruit before tackling the redesign.
Fixing typos on the website is low-hanging fruit.
The consultant went after the low-hanging fruit first.
Once the low-hanging fruit is gone, the hard work begins.

cards.def:
To make a noticeable difference
हिंदी: ठोस असर डालना
examples: Small tweaks won't move the needle on reliability.
A new logo won't move the needle on sales.
We need ideas that really move the needle for customers.
Faster delivery moved the needle on customer satisfaction.

cards.def:
Something that significantly changes a situation
हिंदी: खेल बदलने वाली चीज़
examples: Automated reconciliation was a game changer.
UPI was a game changer for payments in India.
Remote work was a game changer for working parents.
The new hire has been a game changer for our sales team.

cards.def:
A fundamental change in approach or thinking
हिंदी: सोच में बुनियादी बदलाव
examples: Event-driven design was a paradigm shift for the team.
Online learning brought a paradigm shift in education.
Moving to the cloud was a paradigm shift for the company.
Smartphones caused a paradigm shift in how we shop.

cards.def:
Radically changing an industry or process
हिंदी: क्रांतिकारी बदलाव लाने वाला
examples: AI is a disruptive force in software development.
Food delivery apps were disruptive for small restaurants.
Disruptive startups challenge big companies with new ideas.
The new technology is disruptive and will change the industry.

cards.def:
New and unusual
हिंदी: नया और अनोखा
examples: The team came up with a novel approach to deduplication.
The scientist proposed a novel way to clean river water.
Her novel idea for the event got everyone excited.
The startup has a novel approach to home loans.

cards.def:
Not following accepted norms
हिंदी: परंपरागत से हटकर
examples: An unconventional solution solved the problem cheaply.
His unconventional career path took him from music to finance.
The school uses unconventional teaching methods.
Sometimes an unconventional idea is the best one.

cards.def:
Using imagination to produce original ideas
हिंदी: रचनात्मक
examples: A creative workaround saved us a week.
The kids made creative decorations from old newspapers.
She is a creative designer with a strong eye for colour.
We need a creative way to reach younger customers.

cards.def:
To form and develop ideas
हिंदी: विचार गढ़ना
examples: Let's ideate before locking in a design.
The team met for an hour to ideate on new product names.
We ideate freely first and judge the ideas later.
Designers ideate with sketches before using any software.

cards.def:
To form an idea or concept in the mind
हिंदी: अवधारणा बनाना
examples: It's hard to conceptualise the whole flow without a diagram.
The architect conceptualised the building in a single sketch.
It's hard to conceptualise how big a billion rupees is.
She conceptualised the whole campaign around one simple message.

cards.def:
To form a mental picture of something
हिंदी: मन में चित्र बनाना
examples: A diagram helps us visualise the data flow.
Close your eyes and visualise your perfect home.
Athletes visualise the race before they run it.
Charts help managers visualise trends quickly.

cards.def:
To make fast successive improvements
हिंदी: तेज़ी से बार-बार सुधार करना
examples: Iterate quickly and learn from each release.
Startups must iterate quickly to survive.
We iterate quickly by testing ideas with a few users each week.
Short sprints let the team iterate quickly.

cards.def:
To find out quickly whether an idea will not work
हिंदी: जल्दी विफल होकर सीखना
examples: Fail fast to avoid wasting months on a bad design.
Our team culture is to fail fast and learn from it.
Fail fast with a cheap prototype before building the real thing.
If the idea doesn't work, it's better to fail fast.

cards.def:
To change direction in strategy or approach
हिंदी: रणनीति की दिशा बदलना
examples: We pivoted to a managed service after the prototype struggled.
The restaurant pivoted to home delivery during the lockdown.
He pivoted from engineering to product management.
The startup pivoted after customers ignored its first app.

cards.def:
An adjustment to get back on the right path
हिंदी: दिशा सुधार
examples: A course correction in week three saved the project.
The mid-year review led to a course correction in our sales plan.
A small course correction now avoids a big problem later.
After poor exam results, she made a course correction in her study habits.

cards.def:
To consider again after a period of time
हिंदी: दोबारा विचार करना
examples: Let's revisit this decision once we have more data.
Let's revisit the budget after the first quarter.
I revisited my old college last month.
We'll revisit this topic in next week's meeting.

cards.def:
To evaluate again
हिंदी: पुनर्मूल्यांकन करना
examples: We should reassess the risk after the pilot.
After the price rise, I reassessed my monthly budget.
The doctor will reassess your condition after a week.
Let's reassess our goals at mid-year.

cards.def:
To think again about a decision
हिंदी: पुनर्विचार करना
examples: Would you reconsider extending the deadline?
Please reconsider your resignation; we value your work.
The company reconsidered its decision after customer complaints.
I reconsidered buying the car and took the metro instead.

cards.def:
To doubt a decision or criticise it afterwards
हिंदी: निर्णय पर बाद में शक करना
examples: Don't second-guess the call; we had good reasons then.
Stop second-guessing your answers in the exam.
My boss never second-guesses my decisions.
If you keep second-guessing yourself, you'll never decide.

cards.def:
Understanding something after it has happened
हिंदी: बीती घटना की बाद में समझ
examples: In hindsight, we should have load-tested earlier.
In hindsight, I should have saved more money.
Hindsight makes every mistake look obvious.
With hindsight, the delay was the right call.

cards.def:
The ability to predict and prepare for the future
हिंदी: दूरदर्शिता
examples: Her foresight saved us from a major outage.
He had the foresight to buy land before prices went up.
Thanks to her foresight, we had backup laptops ready.
Good planning needs foresight and flexibility.

cards.def:
To predict a future event
हिंदी: भविष्य की घटना देख लेना
examples: Nobody could have foreseen that edge case.
We didn't foresee so much traffic on launch day.
Do you foresee any problems with this plan?
Experts foresee strong growth in electric vehicles.

cards.def:
To take action in advance to prevent something
हिंदी: पहले से रोकथाम करना
examples: We preempted the problem by adding validation.
She preempted questions by sharing a detailed FAQ.
We preempted complaints by informing customers about the delay.
Try to preempt the client's objections in your proposal.

cards.def:
To prevent something by acting in advance
हिंदी: पहले से रोकना
examples: Early communication forestalled a lot of confusion.
Regular servicing forestalls major car repairs.
He forestalled the argument by apologising first.
The new policy aims to forestall employee complaints.

cards.def:
To prevent something bad from happening
हिंदी: संकट टालना
examples: Quick action averted a major data loss.
The driver braked hard and averted an accident.
Talks averted a strike at the factory.
Regular backups averted disaster when the laptop was stolen.

cards.def:
To prevent someone or something from succeeding
हिंदी: विफल करना
examples: Strict validation thwarted the corrupt file from loading.
Police thwarted a bank robbery in the city.
Bad weather thwarted our plans for a picnic.
Two-factor login thwarts most hacking attempts.

cards.def:
To put something at risk
हिंदी: ख़तरे में डालना
examples: Skipping tests could jeopardise the release.
Drinking and driving jeopardises lives.
Don't jeopardise your career with one angry email.
The delay could jeopardise the whole contract.

cards.def:
To gradually weaken something
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे कमज़ोर करना
examples: Repeated outages undermined client confidence.
Gossip can undermine trust within a team.
His constant jokes undermined the seriousness of the meeting.
Don't undermine your manager in front of the client.

cards.def:
To gradually reduce or destroy
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे क्षीण करना
examples: Constant firefighting erodes team morale.
The sea is eroding the coastline every year.
Inflation erodes the value of savings.
Broken promises erode customer loyalty.

cards.def:
To hinder or obstruct
हिंदी: बाधा डालना
examples: Poor documentation hampers onboarding.
Heavy traffic hampered the ambulance.
Lack of funds hampered the project.
The injury hampered his performance in the match.

cards.def:
To delay or prevent progress
हिंदी: प्रगति में रुकावट डालना
examples: Slow approvals impede delivery.
Fallen trees impeded traffic after the storm.
Language barriers can impede communication.
Nothing should impede your right to education.

cards.def:
To make it difficult for something to happen
हिंदी: कठिनाई पैदा करना
examples: Frequent meetings hinder deep work.
Noise from the street hinders my concentration.
Lack of sleep hinders learning.
Strict rules can hinder creativity.

cards.def:
To restrain or keep within limits
हिंदी: नियंत्रित करना
examples: New rules helped curb unnecessary access.
The government took steps to curb inflation.
Try to curb your spending before the holidays.
Schools want to curb mobile phone use in class.

cards.def:
To reduce or limit something
हिंदी: घटाना / सीमित करना
examples: Budget cuts curtailed our hiring plans.
The rain curtailed the cricket match.
The company curtailed travel to save money.
The new law curtails the use of plastic bags.

cards.def:
To limit or restrict
हिंदी: सीमित करना
examples: Legacy systems constrain what we can change.
A small budget constrains our marketing options.
Don't let fear constrain your career choices.
The design was constrained by the size of the room.

cards.def:
Making a process more efficient
हिंदी: प्रक्रिया को सुव्यवस्थित करना
examples: Streamlining approvals saved two days per release.
Streamlining the hiring process cut the time to offer by half.
The bank is streamlining its loan approval steps.
Streamlining meetings gave everyone more time for real work.

cards.def:
Making something as effective as possible
हिंदी: अनुकूलन
examples: Query optimisation reduced costs significantly.
Website optimisation made pages load in under two seconds.
Tax optimisation is legal; tax evasion is not.
Route optimisation saved the delivery company a lot of fuel.

cards.def:
Waste of time, effort or resources
हिंदी: अकुशलता
examples: Manual steps create inefficiency and risk.
Paper forms are a big source of inefficiency in government offices.
The audit found inefficiency in how we buy supplies.
Reduce inefficiency by automating repetitive work.

cards.def:
No longer used or useful
हिंदी: अप्रचलित
examples: The old interface is now obsolete.
Typewriters became obsolete when computers arrived.
This phone model will soon be obsolete.
Some job skills become obsolete within a few years.

cards.def:
Old-fashioned or no longer current
हिंदी: पुराना पड़ चुका
examples: The documentation is outdated and misleading.
My resume is outdated; I need to add my new job.
The rules are outdated and don't fit remote work.
Outdated software can be a security risk.

cards.def:
No longer fresh or up to date
हिंदी: बासी / पुराना
examples: Stale data caused the wrong report.
The bread has gone stale.
The dashboard shows stale numbers from last week.
Clear the cache if the page shows stale content.

cards.def:
Broken into disconnected parts
हिंदी: बिखरा हुआ
examples: Fragmented tooling slows down investigations.
Customer data is fragmented across five different tools.
The country's opposition is fragmented into small parties.
Fragmented sleep leaves me tired all day.

cards.def:
Isolated from other teams or systems
हिंदी: अलग-थलग
examples: Siloed teams duplicate effort.
Siloed departments rarely share useful information.
Our data is siloed, so nobody sees the full picture.
The new manager broke down siloed ways of working.

cards.def:
Repeated unnecessarily
हिंदी: दोहराया गया
examples: Duplicated logic is hard to maintain.
Duplicated records confused the billing team.
We removed duplicated steps from the approval process.
Duplicated effort wastes time and money.

cards.def:
Extremely complex and hard to follow
हिंदी: उलझा हुआ
examples: The convoluted approval flow confuses new joiners.
The movie's plot was so convoluted that I got lost.
Government forms are often convoluted.
His convoluted explanation confused everyone.

cards.def:
Slow and inefficient because of size or complexity
हिंदी: बोझिल
examples: The manual process is too cumbersome.
Carrying a cumbersome suitcase on the train was tiring.
The old billing system is slow and cumbersome.
Cumbersome rules frustrate both staff and customers.

cards.def:
Requiring a lot of human effort
हिंदी: अधिक मानवीय श्रम वाला
examples: Reconciliation was labour-intensive until we automated it.
Farming rice by hand is very labour-intensive.
Data entry is labour-intensive, so we're looking at automation.
Handmade furniture is labour-intensive and costs more.

cards.def:
Likely to produce mistakes
हिंदी: त्रुटि की संभावना वाला
examples: Manual deployment is error-prone.
Copying numbers by hand is error-prone.
The old billing system is slow and error-prone.
Typing long account numbers on a phone is error-prone.

cards.def:
Taking a lot of time
हिंदी: समय लेने वाला
examples: Debugging without logs is time-consuming.
Getting a passport used to be very time-consuming.
Cooking for twenty guests is time-consuming but fun.
Long approval chains make small changes time-consuming.

cards.def:
Simple and uncomplicated
हिंदी: सीधा-सादा
examples: The fix itself was straightforward.
The instructions are straightforward and easy to follow.
Booking a ticket online is straightforward.
She gave me a straightforward answer, and I appreciated it.

cards.def:
Requiring no apparent effort
हिंदी: बिना श्रम के
examples: With good tooling, deployment feels effortless.
She speaks English with effortless fluency.
The dancer made the difficult moves look effortless.
Online banking makes paying bills almost effortless.

cards.def:
So small that it is not worth considering
हिंदी: नगण्य
examples: The performance impact is negligible.
The difference in price between the two shops is negligible.
The side effects of the medicine are negligible.
The risk of data loss here is negligible.

cards.def:
Small and of minor importance
हिंदी: मामूली / सीमांत
examples: The gain from caching was only marginal.
The new process gave only marginal savings.
His English improved, but only marginally.
Marginal changes won't fix a broken process.

cards.def:
Notably large
हिंदी: उल्लेखनीय रूप से बड़ा
examples: Considerable effort went into the migration.
She has considerable experience in sales.
The repairs cost a considerable amount of money.
The new policy caused considerable confusion among staff.

cards.def:
Very great or intense
हिंदी: गहरा
examples: The decision had a profound effect on delivery.
Her father's advice had a profound influence on her career.
The pandemic had a profound impact on how we work.
He felt a profound sense of relief after the exam.

cards.def:
Extreme and far-reaching
हिंदी: कठोर / भारी
examples: Drastic measures were needed to stop the data loss.
The company took drastic steps to cut costs.
Don't make drastic changes to your diet overnight.
A drastic drop in sales worried the owners.

cards.def:
A small step forward in quality
हिंदी: क्रमिक सुधार
examples: Incremental improvement adds up to big gains.
Practising daily brings incremental improvement in your speaking.
Each sprint should deliver some incremental improvement.
Incremental improvement is less exciting but more reliable.

cards.def:
To renovate or improve the form of something
हिंदी: नया रूप देना
examples: The team revamped the onboarding guide.
The restaurant revamped its menu for the new season.
We need to revamp our website; it looks old.
The company revamped its leave policy after feedback.

cards.def:
To give new life to something
हिंदी: नई जान डालना
examples: New tooling revitalised the stagnant project.
The new mayor plans to revitalise the old market area.
A short holiday can revitalise your energy.
The fresh hires revitalised the team's ideas.

cards.def:
To update to suit current needs
हिंदी: आधुनिक बनाना
examples: We are modernising the legacy batch system.
The railway is modernising its stations with escalators.
My parents modernised the kitchen last year.
The bank needs to modernise its mobile app.

cards.def:
To change from one state to another
हिंदी: एक अवस्था से दूसरी में बदलना
examples: We will transition all vendors to the new pipeline by June.
She transitioned from teaching to instructional design.
The office will transition to a four-day week next month.
Help new managers transition smoothly into their role.

cards.def:
To introduce something gradually
हिंदी: चरणबद्ध रूप से लागू करना
examples: We'll roll out the fix to one region first.
The government will roll out the scheme across all states.
We'll roll out the new laptops to the sales team first.
The app update rolls out next week.

cards.def:
To gradually reduce activity until it stops
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे काम समेटना
examples: The project is winding down after launch.
The shop is winding down before it closes for good.
I wind down in the evening by reading a book.
The company is winding down its operations in that country.

cards.def:
To gradually reduce effort or output
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे गति घटाना
examples: We will ramp down support once the new system is stable.
We'll ramp down the temporary staff after the festival rush.
The factory ramped down production during the slow season.
Ramp down overtime once the backlog is cleared.

cards.def:
To reduce in size or extent
हिंदी: दायरा छोटा करना
examples: We scaled back the project to meet the deadline.
We scaled back the wedding because of the budget.
The company scaled back its expansion plans.
Please scale back the scope so we can finish on time.

cards.def:
To increase in size or capacity
हिंदी: क्षमता बढ़ाना
examples: We can scale up the workers when load rises.
The bakery scaled up production for Diwali orders.
We plan to scale up the pilot to all branches.
It's hard to scale up a business without good systems.

cards.def:
Basic truths from which reasoning starts
हिंदी: मूल सिद्धांत
examples: Let's think from first principles instead of copying others.
Elon Musk often talks about thinking from first principles.
From first principles, what does the customer really need?
Learning from first principles helps you understand, not just memorise.

cards.def:
The simplest explanation is usually the best
हिंदी: सबसे सरल व्याख्या अक्सर सही होती है
examples: Occam's razor suggests it's just a config typo.
The phone isn't charging; by Occam's razor, check the cable first.
Occam's razor told us the simplest reason was a typo.
Apply Occam's razor before you build complex theories.

cards.def:
Money or effort already spent that cannot be recovered
हिंदी: पहले ही ख़र्च हो चुकी लागत
examples: Don't let sunk cost keep a failing project alive.
The movie was boring, but I stayed because of sunk cost.
The money spent so far is a sunk cost; decide based on the future.
Sunk cost thinking keeps people in bad jobs too long.

cards.def:
Judging only from successful examples
हिंदी: केवल सफल उदाहरणों से निष्कर्ष निकालना
examples: Case studies often suffer from survivorship bias.
Reading only success stories gives you survivorship bias.
Survivorship bias makes old buildings seem better made.
Looking only at winning startups is a classic survivorship bias.

cards.def:
A systematic error in thinking
हिंदी: सोचने में व्यवस्थित त्रुटि
examples: Cognitive bias affects estimation.
Cognitive bias can make interviewers prefer people like themselves.
Learn about cognitive bias to make better decisions.
Confirmation bias is a common cognitive bias.

cards.def:
Relying too heavily on the first piece of information
हिंदी: पहली जानकारी पर अधिक निर्भर होना
examples: Anchoring on the first quote skewed negotiations.
Shops use anchoring by showing a high original price.
Anchoring made us accept the first salary number offered.
Avoid anchoring by getting several quotes first.

cards.def:
Presenting two options as the only ones available
हिंदी: केवल दो विकल्प दिखाना
examples: Speed versus quality is a false dichotomy.
Saying you're either with us or against us is a false dichotomy.
Work or family is a false dichotomy; many people balance both.
Point out the false dichotomy and suggest a third option.

cards.def:
An argument that a small step leads to extreme results
हिंदी: छोटे कदम से बड़े नतीजे की दलील
examples: One exception isn't necessarily a slippery slope.
Some fear that allowing one late submission is a slippery slope.
He called the new rule a slippery slope towards more control.
Slippery slope arguments often exaggerate the risk.

cards.def:
Misrepresenting someone's argument to attack it easily
हिंदी: विरोधी तर्क को तोड़-मरोड़कर पेश करना
examples: That's a straw man; nobody suggested removing tests.
He attacked a straw man instead of answering my real point.
Don't build a straw man of the other team's proposal.
That's a straw man argument; I never said cost doesn't matter.

cards.def:
A misleading clue that distracts from the real issue
हिंदी: भटकाने वाला संकेत
examples: The memory warning was a red herring.
The detective realised the clue was a red herring.
The argument about fonts was a red herring in the design review.
Don't let red herrings distract from the main issue.

cards.def:
Created for a specific purpose without general planning
हिंदी: तात्कालिक / विशेष उद्देश्य हेतु
examples: Ad hoc fixes make the system harder to maintain.
We hold ad hoc meetings when urgent problems come up.
The committee was formed on an ad hoc basis.
Our reporting is ad hoc, so numbers often don't match.

cards.def:
Breaking problems into clear step-by-step solutions
हिंदी: चरणबद्ध समाधान सोचने की क्षमता
examples: Algorithmic thinking improves debugging.
Coding classes teach children algorithmic thinking.
Algorithmic thinking helps you plan a recipe step by step.
Interviewers test algorithmic thinking with puzzles.

cards.def:
To break a problem into smaller parts
हिंदी: समस्या को छोटे भागों में बाँटना
examples: Decompose the task into tickets of one day each.
Decompose your big goal into small weekly targets.
The teacher showed us how to decompose a long problem.
We decomposed the project into four phases.

cards.def:
To hide complexity behind a simpler layer
हिंदी: जटिलता को सरल परत के पीछे छुपाना
examples: The library abstracts away the retry logic.
The app abstracts away the complexity of filing taxes.
Good APIs abstract away the messy details.
Cloud services abstract away server management.

cards.def:
To apply a specific finding more broadly
हिंदी: विशेष निष्कर्ष को व्यापक रूप से लागू करना
examples: We can't generalise from one vendor's behaviour.
It's unfair to generalise about people from one city.
Don't generalise from a single bad experience.
The findings may generalise to other industries.

cards.def:
To make something seem simpler than it is
हिंदी: ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा सरल बना देना
examples: Blaming one engineer oversimplifies the incident.
The news report oversimplified a complex issue.
Don't oversimplify the problem to get quick approval.
Saying it's just bad luck oversimplifies what happened.

cards.def:
A statement supported by evidence
हिंदी: प्रमाण से समर्थित दावा
examples: Only substantiated claims belong in the report.
A substantiated claim carries more weight in court.
Every substantiated claim in the article has a source.
Insurance pays only for a substantiated claim.

cards.def:
Having no basis in fact
हिंदी: निराधार
examples: The rumour about data loss was unfounded.
Fears of a price rise turned out to be unfounded.
The complaint against her was unfounded.
Don't spread unfounded rumours about colleagues.

cards.def:
Without evidence or reason
हिंदी: बेबुनियाद
examples: The accusation was baseless.
The company called the news report baseless.
His fear of flying is baseless but real to him.
Baseless gossip can damage someone's reputation.

cards.def:
A broad claim made without considering details
हिंदी: बिना बारीकी के व्यापक कथन
examples: Saying all vendors are unreliable is a sweeping statement.
Saying young people don't work hard is a sweeping statement.
Avoid sweeping statements in your performance review.
His sweeping statement about the city upset many people.

cards.def:
A failure to notice or consider something
हिंदी: चूक
examples: The missing alert was an oversight.
Forgetting to invite her was an oversight, not a choice.
Due to an oversight, the invoice was sent twice.
The audit found a serious oversight in the safety checks.

cards.def:
An area where one lacks awareness
हिंदी: जिस पर ध्यान न जाए वह क्षेत्र
examples: Security was a blind spot in our design.
Mirrors help drivers check their blind spot.
My blind spot is not noticing when I talk too much.
Feedback from others helps you see your blind spots.

cards.def:
A gap in a rule that allows avoidance
हिंदी: नियम में कमी का छेद
examples: The loophole let invalid files pass validation.
The government closed a tax loophole for big companies.
He used a loophole in the contract to avoid paying.
Check the policy for loopholes before it goes live.

cards.def:
Possible dangers and protective measures
हिंदी: ख़तरे और बचाव के उपाय
examples: The guide lists pitfalls and safeguards.
The training covered pitfalls and safeguards of online banking.
Every new process should list its pitfalls and safeguards.
We discussed the pitfalls and safeguards of working remotely.

cards.def:
Confidential business information
हिंदी: व्यावसायिक गोपनीय जानकारी
examples: The contract protects trade secrets.
The recipe for the drink is one of the company's trade secrets.
Employees signed an agreement not to share trade secrets.
He was sued for leaking trade secrets to a competitor.

cards.def:
Acting without certainty about the outcome
हिंदी: अनिश्चितता में भरोसा करके कदम उठाना
examples: Adopting the new platform was a leap of faith.
Leaving a stable job to start a business was a leap of faith.
Moving to a new country is always a leap of faith.
Hiring someone without experience felt like a leap of faith.

cards.def:
A risk taken after careful thought
हिंदी: सोच-समझकर लिया गया जोखिम
examples: Shipping early was a calculated risk.
Investing in the new market was a calculated risk.
She took a calculated risk and switched careers at thirty.
Every startup founder takes calculated risks.

cards.def:
A second verification
हिंदी: दोबारा जाँच
examples: Do a double-check before sending the numbers.
Give the address a double-check before booking the cab.
A double-check on the invoice saved us from overpaying.
Make a double-check part of your routine for important emails.

cards.def:
To verify using a different source
हिंदी: दूसरे स्रोत से मिलान करना
examples: Cross-check the totals with the vendor report.
Cross-check the news with another source before sharing it.
The accountant cross-checked the bills with the bank statement.
Always cross-check passport details before booking flights.

cards.def:
To compare performance with a standard
हिंदी: मानक से तुलना करना
examples: We benchmarked the new parser against the old one.
We benchmarked our salaries against similar companies.
Benchmark against last year to see how much you've improved.
The new phone was benchmarked against its main rival.

cards.def:
To test under extreme conditions
हिंदी: चरम स्थितियों में परखना
examples: We stress-tested the platform with ten times the volume.
Banks stress-test their finances against a market crash.
We stress-tested the website before the big sale.
Stress-test your budget by assuming income drops by twenty percent.

cards.def:
To quickly verify that a result is reasonable
हिंदी: तर्कसंगतता जाँचना
examples: Sanity-check the report totals before sharing.
Sanity-check the travel plan before booking everything.
I always sanity-check my maths with a quick estimate.
Ask a colleague to sanity-check your slides.

cards.def:
A discussion after an event to review what happened
हिंदी: घटना के बाद की समीक्षा चर्चा
examples: We held a debrief after the release.
The pilots attended a debrief after the flight.
Let's do a quick debrief after the client meeting.
The debrief helped the new team understand what went wrong.

cards.def:
Insights gained from experience
हिंदी: अनुभव से मिली सीख
examples: Capture lessons learned in the postmortem.
Share the lessons learned with the next project team.
One lesson learned was to involve users earlier.
Our lessons learned document helps us avoid repeat mistakes.

cards.def:
Information held by long-term employees
हिंदी: संस्था में दीर्घकालिक अनुभव से बना ज्ञान
examples: Institutional knowledge leaves when seniors resign.
Write down institutional knowledge before people retire.
She holds a lot of institutional knowledge about our clients.
Losing institutional knowledge slows new teams down.
